page.overview:
Who is Big Daddy?

Charles "Big" Daddy is a villain in that appeared in the Wiggum, P.I. segment of the non-canon episode "The Simpsons Spin-Off Showcase".

He was voiced by the late Gailard Sartain.

In the section he tried to kill Chief Wiggum (he actually sent a "warning 'gator" with corked teeth, probably to distract him) and then he kidnapped Ralph Wiggum. He is extremely overweight, and teaches Ralph to play the spoons during his kidnapping. He stole the governor's mansion as a hideout. He escapes from Skinner and Wiggum at the end of the segment.
